title: The rover disabled until the tank comes; bonded piles hold (a grace, seepage slowed by a pile's bodies, a sector's cap)
context: Measured after the economy build (docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-12): unescorted the rover took 6-15 bites and still came home with 4,438-5,342 kg of 6,500 laid (escorted 5,950), so the escort was not worth the tank's trip; sector 3 seeped 61 % of all laid (42,768 kg) from a flat 0.5 kg/s floor on each of hundreds of small piles. Owner: "leaning towards the tank doing sorties and protection missions of the yushi-rover collecting biomass"; "biomass bonds together well, otherwise it seeps into the ground and some is lost"; "we will tune the difficulty later, first we want the flow of stages". Branch escort-seep from e4e9cefb.
outcome: ac8971e2: ROVER.disable { bites 3, every 2, floor 0.25, cells 3, seconds 4 } (src/domain/rover-run.js bite, restart, restartShare): the third jab of a trip (an empty hold counts) disables the rover where it stands; disabled it is bitten one bite in 2 s at most down to a quarter of its capacity; only the tank (the hull alive) within 3 cells for 4 s restarts it (the hold's clock runs down while the tank is away), and it resumes its trip; still no hit points; the break brings a disabled rover home with what is aboard. Readouts: the console ROVER DISABLED · NEEDS THE TANK / ROVER RESTARTING n %, the callouts, Isao's rover_disabled caption once, a red restart ring with an amber arc (src/fx/rover.js), the radar's rover mark (olive while out, blinking red with a ring while disabled, src/fx/radar-scope.js; td-tab +1 line), the first sortie's hint callout. 3371ccd7: FIELD.seep { grace 20, floor 0.5, share 1/400, bond 3, cap 0.25 } (src/domain/biomass-field.js): no seepage for 20 s after a pile's first body; then max(floor, kg x share) / min(bodies, bond) kg/s; a sector's seepage stops at 25 % of its laid kg (field.term() at the break); a full field drops its smallest pile. Measured: --rover unescorted disabled at 4,110 kg, held (0.00 m in 6 s), the hull beside it restarted it after 10.6 s, home with 5,814 kg; escorted 0 bites, never disabled, home with 6,000. --ledger TO=3 BOARD=pick: laid 11,296 / 25,206 / 69,939, home 275 / 16,546 / 26,401, seeped 138 / 1,006 / 11,663 (1 / 4 / 17 %), bank at the debriefs 3,075 / 18,271 / 35,272 (before: home 1,794 / 13,756 / 22,112, seeped 390 / 2,735 / 42,768, bank 4,594 / 17,000 / 29,712).
alternatives: Bites end the trip (home at once with what is left): rejected, the rover would still come home and the tank would not have to go.
Bond 8 with the grace renewed by every body: measured 0 / 0.4 / 7 % seeped (S3 under the 15-30 % band); a lane under a stream of kills never seeped.
Bond 8 with the grace from the first body: 0.4 / 1 / 7 %; taken: bond 3 (S3 17 %).
Bonding by neighbouring piles: not built (the field would need the lattice's distances every tick).
A disabled rover losing its load at the break: not taken; the break banks what is aboard (the floor at worst).
evidence: --rover PASS 9 on the final tree (harvest, unload, after, disabled, hunted, escorted, reroute, no-road; the first sortie's hint said); an earlier run on the escort commit alone passed the disabled, hunted and escorted pages and failed 'no road: held' once (the rover drove past the shut ring before the recheck; passed on the rerun, nothing in the change touches it).
--dog-scout PASS 9 (DOG BUDGET: first harvest poured 391 of 433 laid, card 2,491).
--ledger TO=3 BOARD=pick, four runs: bond 8 renewed grace (S3 7 %), bond 8 first-body grace (S3 7 %), bond 3 (the rows in the outcome).
npm test (347 programs) and npm run check green at both commits; test/rover-run.mjs, test/biomass-field.mjs, test/radar-scope.mjs gained the rules' cases.
Not run: --story-world (known flaky / red on the base), the colony or landing suites; not played by hand.
